{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows early negative signals.",
    "Increase forecast bias correction by 10-15% when recent history shows persistent overestimation (e.g., 3+ consecutive forecast > true outcome).",
    "Apply mean reversion to forecasts when true outcome deviates > 5% from 30-day moving average of history.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcome shows sharp upward spike (e.g., >10% from prior 5-day high).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when price is near historical highs (e.g., >70% of 30-day range).",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is 2-3 days ahead of forecast, adjust forecast upward by 2-5% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below true outcome, consider increasing forecast by 3-5% to capture sentiment-driven momentum."
  ]
}
